workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College Borough Boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate polygon boundary for State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a registered polygon dataset representing the State College borough boundary. The candidate must be inspected at runtime for spatial coverage, vector geometry, CRS, and GeoPackage compatibility.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject Census Tracts to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the census tract geometries from EPSG:26918 to the DEM CRS EPSG:3857 for compatible spatial overlay and zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the census tract GeoPackage from its observed source CRS to EPSG:3857. Preserve tract attributes and polygon geometry.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject Borough Boundary to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:3857 so it can be overlaid with the census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved State College borough boundary to EPSG:3857 after runtime inspection confirms that its source CRS is present and known. Preserve polygon geometry.

workflow_steps.title: Derive Census Tracts Intersecting State College Borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Identify the census tract geometries that intersect the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a polygon intersection overlay between the projected census tracts and projected State College borough boundary. Retain tract identity attributes, including the observed GEOID field, so the resulting zones remain attributable to census tracts.

workflow_steps.title: Compute Mean Elevation by Intersecting Census Tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate mean DEM elevation for each derived census-tract intersection zone.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics using the DEM and the intersecting census tract polygons. Produce a CSV summary containing the mean elevation for each tract zone and retain the tract identifier from the zone layer.

workflow_steps.title: Convert Borough Boundary to Consumer-Compatible Vector Dataset
workflow_steps.purpose: Reconcile the retrieved borough boundary representation before reprojection while preserving its analytical role.
workflow_steps.instructions: Convert the retrieved borough boundary into a GeoPackage vector representation accepted by the downstream reprojection task. Preserve polygon geometry, attributes, CRS metadata, and the borough_boundary role.

requirements.scope: The retrieved borough boundary must represent State College borough.
The retrieved borough boundary must be available in a vector format accepted by reprojection and overlay, preferably GeoPackage.
The retrieved borough boundary must have a known source CRS before reprojection.
The borough boundary must contain valid, non-empty polygon geometry for reprojection and overlay.
The projected census tracts and projected borough boundary must use compatible CRSs for polygon overlay.
Both projected polygon inputs must have valid, non-empty geometries for overlay.
The intersecting tract output must retain the observed census tract identifier field GEOID.
The DEM and intersecting tract zones must use compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
The intersecting tract zones must contain valid, non-empty polygon geometries for zonal statistics.
The zonal statistics output must retain the census tract identifier GEOID for each mean elevation result.
